title: The schedule
vo: So the schedule is: tip out and pre-shape at 7, and shape at about 25 past. Heat the pot at half past 8, and bake at a quarter past 9. Take the lid off at 25 to 10, and cut the loaf from about 11. Or prove it in the fridge for 8 to 16 hours, and bake it straight from cold.
